question: Should ClawHub formally adopt installable “Claws” as its primary app-store object and the proposed runtime, hosting, publisher, credential, and safety boundaries as durable product direction?
rationale: Source inspection can assess editorial consistency but cannot determine whether maintainers intend these strategic commitments or prefer a vision limited to the current registry model.

options.title: Adopt the Claw direction
options.body: Approve the terminology and boundaries, merge the vision, and capture implementation-sensitive invariants in focused specs as development proceeds.

options.title: Narrow to current capabilities
options.body: Replace the stale OpenClaw copy with a vision limited to the existing skills/plugins registry, discovery, trust, and publisher model.

options.title: Develop an RFC first
options.body: Keep the vision conservative while the Claw object and its runtime and security contracts are developed in a dedicated product specification.

recommendation.title: Adopt the Claw direction
recommendation.body: Approve the terminology and boundaries, merge the vision, and capture implementation-sensitive invariants in focused specs as development proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository collaborator presenting the concrete product model and are the strongest available person to coordinate broader owner approval.
